heading: Divaine Tech is an IT company that helps businesses grow
with smart technology.
intro.text: At Divaine Tech we design, build and support technology that helps businesses work smarter. Our teams collaborate across web, mobile, cloud, data and AI projects, and every member has room to learn, lead and make a visible impact. If you enjoy solving real problems alongside talented, supportive colleagues, we would like to hear from you.

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Executive
jobs.summary: Plan and run data-driven campaigns across SEO, paid media and social channels to grow our brand and generate quality leads.
overview: As Digital Marketing Executive you will own the planning and execution of our online campaigns, helping Divaine Tech reach and convert the right audience. You will work closely with our design, content and sales teams to turn business goals into measurable marketing results.
This role suits an analytical, creative marketer who enjoys testing ideas, reading the numbers and continuously improving performance across search, social, email and paid channels.

responsibilities.title: Job Responsibilities
responsibilities.intro: You will manage campaigns end to end, from strategy and creative briefs to reporting and optimization.
items: Plan, launch and optimize SEO, PPC and social media campaigns
Track KPIs and report on traffic, leads and return on investment
Coordinate with designers and writers to produce high-quality campaign content
Manage email marketing, newsletters and lead nurturing workflows
Research competitors, keywords and audience trends
Maintain a consistent brand voice across all digital channels

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.intro: We are looking for a motivated marketer with a solid grasp of digital channels and analytics.
items: Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business or a related field
1–3 years of experience in digital marketing
Hands-on knowledge of Google Analytics, Google Ads and social platforms
Strong written communication and analytical skills
Ability to manage multiple campaigns and meet deadlines

jobs.title: Sr. WordPress Developer
jobs.summary: Lead the design and development of fast, secure and scalable WordPress websites, custom themes and plugins for our clients.
overview: As Senior WordPress Developer you will take ownership of client websites from architecture through launch, building custom themes and plugins that are fast, secure and easy for clients to manage.
You will mentor junior developers, review code and help us raise the standard of every WordPress project we deliver.

responsibilities.title: Job Responsibilities
responsibilities.intro: You will lead technical delivery on WordPress projects and guide the team on best practices.
items: Develop custom WordPress themes and plugins from approved designs
Optimize websites for speed, security and SEO
Integrate third-party APIs, payment gateways and CRM tools
Review code and mentor junior developers
Maintain, update and troubleshoot live client websites
Estimate tasks and collaborate with project managers and designers

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.intro: We are looking for an experienced developer with a strong portfolio of WordPress projects.
items: 4+ years of professional WordPress development experience
Strong skills in PHP, MySQL, JavaScript, HTML and CSS
Experience with custom post types, REST API and WooCommerce
Familiarity with Git and performance optimization techniques
Excellent problem-solving and teamwork skills

jobs.title: Product Designer
jobs.summary: Shape intuitive, beautiful digital products by turning user research and business goals into polished interfaces and design systems.
overview: As Product Designer you will design web and mobile experiences that are easy to use and visually refined. You will take ideas from research and wireframes through to final UI, working side by side with developers and product managers.
We value designers who combine strong visual craft with a clear understanding of users and business goals.

responsibilities.title: Job Responsibilities
responsibilities.intro: You will own the design process from discovery to hand-off and help evolve our design system.
items: Conduct user research and translate findings into design decisions
Create wireframes, prototypes and high-fidelity UI designs
Build and maintain a consistent design system and component library
Collaborate with developers to ensure accurate implementation
Run usability tests and iterate based on feedback
Present design concepts and rationale to clients and stakeholders

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.intro: We are looking for a creative, detail-oriented designer with a strong portfolio.
items: Strong portfolio showcasing UI/UX and product design work
Proficiency in Figma and other modern design tools
Solid understanding of user-centred design and accessibility
Creative mindset with the ability to solve problems simply
Excellent communication and teamwork skills

jobs.title: Jr. Content Writer
jobs.summary: Write clear, engaging content for our website, blog and social channels while learning from experienced marketing and technology teams.
overview: As Junior Content Writer you will create articles, web copy and social posts that explain technology in a clear and engaging way. This is a great opportunity to build your career in a supportive team that values learning.
You will work with our marketing and design teams to research topics, draft content and improve it based on feedback and performance data.

responsibilities.title: Job Responsibilities
responsibilities.intro: You will produce well-researched content that supports our brand and helps clients understand our services.
items: Write blog posts, case studies and website copy
Research industry topics and gather accurate information
Proofread and edit content for clarity, grammar and tone
Optimize content with basic SEO best practices
Support social media and email content creation
Collaborate with designers to align copy and visuals

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.intro: We welcome motivated writers who are eager to learn and grow.
items: Bachelor’s degree in English, journalism, marketing or a related field
0–2 years of content writing experience, internships included
Excellent command of written English and attention to detail
Interest in technology and willingness to research new topics
Ability to take feedback and meet deadlines
